goal: Make the AI authoring JSON use composition.clips[] as the top-level unit, where each clip owns anchors, tracks, TTS timeline, subtitles, and renderable items.

items.title: Add clip-first composition schema
items.acceptance: A sample composition with three top-level clips compiles to the existing runtime source format.

items.title: Model TTS and subtitle timelines as tracks
items.acceptance: subtitle tracks can read words from a same-clip subtitle_timeline generated by nftts.

items.title: Show top-level clips in the editor
items.acceptance: The left list selects video clips; the timeline shows tracks/items for the selected clip.

items.title: Expose clip/track/item address paths
items.acceptance: composition show/patch supports clip, track, item, and field selectors.
